verdict.rationale: Hightouch's official MCP server lets an AI assistant build audiences in plain language, with a documented example prompt that defines a cart-abandonment audience. Its listed capabilities include 'understand your customer schema, build audiences', which suggests the generated definitions are grounded in the user's actual schema. The built-in agent also explores segments in natural language. Missing for 10: an explicit review/approve step before the AI-built segment is saved or activated, detail on how the schema grounding works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-to-segment quality.
